The creator of MomTok, she made international headlines when she broke the Swinging Scandal. Suddenly ostracized from her community and friends, Taylor strives to reclaim her spot in MomTok, her friends, and her reputation. Her journey included one in a rocky relationship with Dakota Mortensen, the father of her third child. She struggled with commitment to Dakota after their mutually destructive pasts. Season 2-4 Taylor Frankie Paul, 30[1] Relationship Status: It’s complicated[1] Kids: 3[1] TikTok Followers: 5.1 Million[1] Known for: Being the pioneer woman of MomTok, revealing the “soft swinging” controversy and her involvement in it to the world, and getting herself into sticky situations.[1] Season 1 TikTok: 4.1M[2] Instagram: 363k[2] Fun fact: Creator of #MomTok and the center of the swinging scandal.[2] Why she's excited about the show: I want people to have a better understanding of who I am. I wanted to be vulnerable and show people that when you hit rock bottom, there is hope.[2] Relationship Status: Divorced and just gave birth to her third child with her boyfriend, Dakota.[2] Secret Lives of Mormon Wives[] Season 1[] In "The First Book of Taylor", 28-year-old Taylor Frankie Paul is the catalyst of the swinging scandal that rocked MomTok in May of 2022. She is a self-described wild child who got married in the temple right after high school. She felt pressured by her mom and the church because she and Tate were having premarital sex. She started MomTok with four girls - Whitney, Mayci, Mikayla, and Taylor. Taylor's been keeping a low profile since the scandal and hasn't seen the girls in months. She gradually begins meeting up with the girls to hash out their problems. She finds the most difficulty with Whitney, who Taylor didn't even know was moving back to Utah. Whitney blames Taylor for her move to Hawaii because the scandal ruined her family. She feels betrayed by Taylor and can't trust her. Meanwhile, Taylor meets with her mother Liann who isn't happy with the way things have gone for her daughter and isn't afraid to share that. Taylor drops two bombshells on her mom - that she's officially dating Dakota and that she needs a pregnancy test. Whitney calls an emergency MomTok group meeting and shares the real reason she moved to Hawaii - and it has nothing to do with Taylor. Turns out, Connor was on Tinder and had an addiction to adult film sites, so Whitney moved her family to avoid dealing with the fallout and embarrassment. Taylor is rightfully furious in her confessional that she's been the scapegoat for Whitney's drama. As the girls rally around Whitney, Taylor reveals a trauma of her own - she's four week pregnant but actively going through a miscarriage. She's been in and out of the hospital for days. Whitney, in her confessional, is annoyed that Taylor stole her moment. Taylor continues to navigate her relationship with Dakota which is "officially official". However, he is a recovering addict and needs people who are committed to sobriety. She struggles with the idea of never drinking again. He is adamant this is a deal breaker for him. In a confessional, Taylor decides to get drunk that night despite Dakota's wishes. She becomes heavily intoxicated and a fight breaks out between her and Dakota that results in the police being called. While their statements are conflicting, Taylor admits to throwing chairs at Dakota which damaged the wall. She's arrested for domestic violence and her police bodycam video is shown. In The Book of Belonging, In The Book of Saints & Sinners, In The Book of Truth, In The Book of Broken Vows, In The First Book of Sin, In The Book of Trust, In The Book of Rumors, Season 2[] In The Book of Revelations, it's been a few months since the release of Season 1 and Taylor's life has drastically changed as she navigates a newfound sense of stardom. MomTok has taken off all across the country and brand deals are way up, though Taylor isn't celebrating because she's a new mother navigating a difficult time in her relationship with Dakota. He swore nothing had happened between them when he and Taylor were dating, but later came forward and admitted to her there was more. She was lied to for two years. She feels betrayed and is in denial. She doesn't know if she wants to move forward. Her life and place within the group is further complicated when Miranda McWhorter returns wanting to rejoin the group after leaving because of the scandal. Taylor and Mayci arrange a meeting with Jenna, the girl from Mayci's Sinner Sunday confessions that allegedly had a relationship with Dakota. The meeting goes well, as Jenna only wants the best for Taylor, and Taylor doesn't blame Jenna for the situation because she understands that Jenna was manipulated as well. Through Jenna's texts, Taylor learns the extent of Dakota's lies and betrayal, including how he was going on dates with Jenna but only hung out with Taylor at night. She breaks down in full sobs. She feels like the “night girl” who didn't get the sweet messages or dates. She feels like trash because of him. She regrets not waiting to go further with him. Mayci tries to comfort her friend, who is screaming into her hands that she “hates him” and “hates it”. She visits her mom and tells her everything she's learned from Jenna. Taylor also opens up in a confessional about the brief, yet impactful, time she met her biological father and the lingering issues she has from that encounter. Liann wishes her daughter had thought about things more before getting pregnant by Dakota, like they all told her, because it hurts everyone, not just Taylor. She tells Taylor to focus on her three children, reminding her of the ideals of the LDS church. She blames Taylor's generation for dismissing a relationship just because it doesn't work out. Taylor does love Dakota but can't trust him, so she's asked Dakota to move out while they work through their issues. Taylor is forced to confront the swinging drama and issues with Miranda at a happy hour that Miranda hosts. Taylor only came because she's trying to take control of her life. She also wants to make sure Miranda doesn't lie about the scandal. Taylor is frustrated that Miranda is lying through her teeth and trying to ruin the friendships she has with her girls. She hopes Miranda doesn't lie because it will get messy. In The Book of Accountability, In The Book of Retribution, In The Book of Taboos, In The Book of Divisions, In The Book of Redemption, In The Book of Gratitude, In The Book of Betrayal, In The Book of Reckoning, In The Book of Salvation, In Reunion Special, Season 3[] In The Book of Doubt, Taylor is working on her relationship with Dakota while co-parenting their son, Ever. She’s going away on a two-week mental health retreat to hopefully break some of the toxic cycles. he declines Dakota’s offer to attend church, saying she only goes when she wants because it’s personal for her; she can live in the grey area while others can’t. She is missing some MomTok events, but her decision to step away is supported by the girls. In The Book of Fidelity, Taylor is back from her retreat and catches up with Dakota at a coffee shop. She's feeling much better and learned a lot of tools while away. Dakota came for a few sessions and they are finding a way to coparent better. She’s not going to be in a relationship until she’s in a healthier place. They discuss custody agreements and he fills her in on the drama that she's missed while she's away, including Jessi's emotional affair with villa castmate Marciano. In The Book of Demi, Taylor is looking to the future of MomTok and brings it up during dinner. They’re in agreement that Demi isn’t allowed back, ever. The girls discuss voting Miranda into the group, with the vote finally making her an official member. Jessi announces her decision to meet with Marciano to confront her about the claims they slept together. Taylor can’t think of anything worse to do, especially since Jordan is hurting so much over the incident. The next day, she eavesdrops with the girls on Jessi's lie-detector test with Marciano. The group goes out to dinner after the test, and Taylor doesn't understand the girls infatuation with Marciano. The test results are in and Jessi passed everything - except whether their was physical contact. In The Book of Deceit, Taylor calls a meeting with MomTok to discuss Jessi and Jordan's relationship. Jessi opens up about the struggles in her marriage, including him being verbally abusive. Jessi breaks down in sobs over not knowing what to do and not wanting a second divorce. Taylor warns there’s a lot of pain coming, but also sympathizes. The next day, the girls head to an MCO Beauty Event, which marks Jen's return since her break. Taylor is supportive of Jen and has been the only member in contact with her. Meanwhile, all of MomTok - barring Jessi - are invited to Jordan's barbecue where he confronts the girls for making light of his situation. Taylor advises Jordan to keep their problems between them. Jordan tries to get the girls to understand his perspective with how things would be if the situation was reversed. Jordan has an issue with Mayci and Mikayla specifically because of how they handled Dakota. As the argument dies down, MomTok admits that they do appreciate his accountability. In The Book of Resurrection, Jessi convenes Mayci, Mikayla, and Taylor for brunch to discuss the barbeque. Taylor, however, sees things a bit differently, because she doesn’t think they should bash the relationship. Jordan owned up to a lot of things in the conversation. Later, Taylor brings the girls to a goat farm where she tells them how their manager called her and Dancing with the Stars wants to choose one of them to be on the show. They all need to audition during their LA press tour. Meanwhile, Miranda tells everyone that she's inviting Whitney to her upcoming birthday party, which Taylor supports. MomTok goes to the HydroJug event and didn't bring production along. Taylor encouraged everyone to start recording when they saw Demi there. Demi pulls Layla for a conversation and Taylor, after hearing more of Demi's involvement in insisting Jessi had sex with Marciano, intervenes to pull Layla away. Jessi sees Demi across the room claiming she’s mimicking LAyla, though it’s not caught on camera. Jessi shouts “f*ck you” across the room, with Demi asks how it was f*cking Marciano twice. An explosive shouting match ensues until Taylor defuses Jessi. The next time the girls are together are at Miranda's birthday party. Taylor is glad that she and Miranda can joke about the past, but she does think the group is getting a bit weird now. Whitney's presence causes a stir as Jen accuses Whitney of being transactional. She hates Whitney for being friends with Demi. Taylor watches Whitney leave, and decides to protect MomTok from Whitney. Two days before the LA press tour, MomTok convenes to discuss Whitney and the leader of the group. Jen is upset that Whitney came back for DWTS because Jen wants to be on the show. The girls vote for Taylor as the leader of MomTok because she’s fearless and can have uncomfortable conversations. She will also be the one keeping Whitney and Demi out of the group. The next day, Miranda brings Whitney to a MomTok meeting where Taylor confronts her about being back in the group. Whitney feels like no one wants to be her friend despite her trying very hard to prove herself. As she defends her choices and becomes emotional over losing friendships, she admits the so-called sisterhood is nothing but a business. She announces her plan to start her own MomTok so she can have a place that feels welcoming to her. All of the girls, except Miranda, break out into laughter at Whitney. She get sup and leaves, clearly hurt by their taunts. In The Book of Confrontation, the cast attends the Hulu: Get Real event, meeting the Kardashians cast. MomTok is getting ready for Stagecoach, which will bring them back into Whitney's orbit. Most of the girls don’t care about Whitney anymore, though Taylor sees something in her that she hopes to get to the root of. She visits Whitney in the makeup room and apologizes for how their last meeting went. Whitney once again makes it clear that she is back for DWTS. She tried to make friendships and they didn’t reciprocate, so she’s accepted that all they want is a business relationship. Taylor hopes they can all be coworkers at the very least. In The Book of Broken Hearts, it's time for Stagecoach and Taylor invites DadTok so they can squash the drama between the two groups. Her decision not to completely remove Whitney frustrates Mikayla. However, Taylor's family member was diagnosed with cancer, so she's relaxing on past issues. MomTok and DadTok head to Stagecoach where they meet Lana del Ray. Taylor spies on Dakota during the entire ordeal because she sees him talking to other people. She grills Dakota about what happened and accuses him of doing something he wasn’t doing. In confessionals, Taylor admits she’s upset because she loved Dakota and didn’t want to break up with him. Back at the house, Taylor and Dakota hook up after she reached out to Dakota, which amuses the producers. In the morning, the girls tease Taylor for hooking up with him. Demi shakes the group with a post saying she hasn't been believed about her sexual assault allegations. Whitney reposts the message, which annoys the other girls in the group. Taylor confronts her about the choice and Whitney defends her decision. The conversation spirals into Taylor calling all of MomTok swingers, though Taylor points out how she said clearly that not all of them were involved. Whitney is fine with just doing her content and leaving. Day two of Stagecoach sees Taylor and Dakota seemingly back together, with a great party happening on the bus. Back at the house, Mikayla opens up to Taylor and Mayci about intimacy issues because of her assaults. Taylor speaks to Jace the next morning about the situation. Taylor longs for the connection and certainty that Jace has with Mikayla. She loves their relationship and hopes they can both be patient with each other. Jace asks Taylor about what happened between her and Dakota. She’s hopeful they can rekindle something by getting over their wounds. She thinks it’s time to give their relationship a try. On the way home, Jordan drops a bombshell to Jessi about Dakota. He hooked up with one of Liann's friends. Jessi knows she has to tell Taylor. In The Book of Awakening, Taylor and Dakota are in a great place and post photos together on social media. He asks about the ‘I love you’ that she dropped last night. She admits saying that she will always love him. They’re in such a good place. The next day, MomTok goes to the Utah Pride Centers to host an event. Taylor teases Layla for dating Mason McWhorter, the brother of Chase McWhorter, whom Layla previously dated. Chase is also the ex-husband of Miranda. Taylor is on her way to the airport for press obligations when she gets a call from her therapist asking for an emergency session with her and Dakota. She couldn't go because of the obligations, so she made Dakota tell her over the phone. Dakota admitted to hooking up with the equivalent of her family member who was at Christmases with the family. Taylor is so grossed out by the situation and hasn’t told Liann yet. This betrayal is not mendable and her heart is broken because she had hope before. She will never consider dating Dakota ever again. In The Book of Judgement, MomTok touches down in LA for press week. Taylor dreads telling her friends about Dakota's latest stint. She's about to go on Jimmy Kimmel and wonders if he sabotaged another opportunity for her. She tells the girls that she nearly didn't come because of a fight she had with Dakota. The girls are worried about her, but also about Demi, since news leaked that the girls needed to be separated. Taylor decides to tell Liann about Dakota's betrayal - and the family friend's. Dakota will also be at the premiere with DadTok. Taylor hopes he stays the fuck out of her way. Taylor and Whitney are paired together for their Jimmy Kimmel interview. They have a heart-to-heart with Taylor admitting she likes Whitney and considers them friends. They don’t know what’s going on in everyone’s lives. Both of them think having a mediator would be good to have in future group conversations when there’s an issue. Taylor opens up about being sad over Dakota, but doesn't go into specifics. Whitney supports her and understands. She tries to get Taylor excited for the interview. They concoct a plan to fight over the seat closest to Jimmy and practice the skit. In the interview, Whitney agrees to lift her social media block against Taylor. Afterward, Jessi and Taylor have their talk where Jessi admits to knowing about Dakota's betrayal. They share stories, with Jessi's being a bit more in-depth than what he told Taylor. Taylor starts crying over the situation and Jessi’s heart breaks for her. Taylor had a suspicion of their flirtations but Dakota called her crazy. This is the fourth girl that he’s done this with. Jessi hugs her and they cry together. Taylor is now going to be uncomfortable at her family parties and explains how the woman was close to them during photos of her being pregnant. She didn’t think about being insecure around another woman in her parent’s home. Taylor steps aside to call Dakota while Jessi goes inside to see the girls. Dakota swears there was only one photo sent. He never planned to meet up with her either and accuses Jessi of just saying shit. She threatens to call the woman and gets what she can before hanging up. Once back in Utah, Taylor and her parents decide to call the woman to get information or an apology. In The Book of Enlightenment, In Reunion Special, Season 4[] In The Book of Taking Flight, In The Book of Secrets, In The Book of True Colors, In The Book of Exodus, In The Book of Power and Pain, In The Book of Conceit, In The Book of Fragile Egos, In The Book of Unearthing, In The Book of Coveting, In The Book of Thorns and Roses, Relationships[] MomTok[] Demi Engemann Taylor and Demi initially seemed close during Season 1, with Demi largely supporting Taylor's choices and decisions. This changed between seasons when Demi allegedly asked for more money and was okay with "kicking Jessi off" the show. Their feud came to a head at the end of Season 2, when Demi was infuriated by Taylor shaming MomTok for not publicly praising her after the CMA's. Demi felt Taylor was dragging MomTok into toxicity and wanted to kick her out. She tried to rally the other girls behind her, but ultimately, the girls did not back Demi and she left in tears. Their feud continued behind the scenes and into Season 3, though they seemingly buried the hatchet after both women apologized for their actions and took accountability for their parts in the feud. Jennifer Affleck: Jessi Ngatikaura: Layla Taylor: Mayci Neeley: Mikayla Matthews: Whitney Leavitt: Taylor's relationship with Whitney has been rocky since the Swinging Scandal because Whitney didn't like that Taylor claimed "everyone" was involved when Whitney wasn't. It negatively affected her relationship with the church and her husband. When Whitney returned to Utah she wanted her old life back and that included being the de-facto leader of MomTok, though she didn't know Taylor also wanted the title back. However, things changed during Taylor's third pregnancy as she no longer cared about the drama, though Whitney still held a grudge. Romances[] Dakota Mortensen: (Taylor and Dakota) Taylor's relationship with Dakota is a central plot line for her throughout the series, mainly because of their toxicity and constant up-and-downs. They frequently break up and are then back together, both struggling with trust issues and trauma. They unexpectedly became pregnant with their son Ever, which changed their relationship forever. Taylor still didn't want to marry Dakota because she didn't trust him fully. Despite their pregnancy bliss, she learned her instincts were right when a girl named Jenna claimed to have slept with Dakota while he dated Taylor. This became the crux of their problems and their relationship is left up in the air. Appearances[] For additional appearances, please see Taylor Frankie Paul/Appearances. Tate also requested that Taylor not show their children on the series, which is why her children's faces are blurred or they're not filmed entirely in a scene.[3] Taylor was originally approached to be a cast member on The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City before the swinging scandal broke. She did an interview for the production but was told she didn't have enough drama in her life.[4] Taylor described herself as "the drama" of the group.[5] Taylor is the only cast member who wore four outfits in her Season 1 confessionals. Taylor was cast in Season 22 of The Bachelorette and .was the first non-Bachelor franchise member to be The Bachelorette. ABC canceled the season on March 19, 2026,[6] following the release of a video allegedly depicting Taylor committing domestic violence against Dakota in 2023.[7] Taylor responded to the video being leaked in a statement saying, "Taylor is very grateful for ABC’s support as she prioritizes her family’s safety and security. After years of silently suffering extensive mental and physical abuse as well as threats of retaliation, Taylor is finally gaining the strength to face her accuser and taking steps to ensure that she and her children are protected from any further harm. There are too many women who are suffering in silence as they survive aggressive, jealous ex-partners who refuse to let them move on with their lives. Taylor has remained silent out of fear of further abuse, retaliation and public shaming. She is currently exploring all of her options, seeking support, and preparing to own and share her story." It continued in part, "It’s sad to see the latest installment of his never-ending, desperate, attention-seeking, destructive campaign to harm Taylor without any regard for the consequences for their child. Releasing an old video, which conveniently omits context, on their son's birthday is a reprehensible attempt to distract from his own behavior. Thankfully, the public has seen this act before and knows who he is and sadly, many will recognize this pattern of manipulation, both in his actions on the show, and from their own experiences."[8] Dakota filed a restraining order against her that same day on March 19th, claiming two arguments from February 24th and 25th resulted in violence.[9] Taylor lost at least two brand deals following the allegations made against her by Dakota. The first was Cinnabon, which backed out of partnerships with The Bachelorette and The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives. She was the face of the campaign that was pulled.[10] The second was Meta, who backed out of their brand deal.[11] Taylor Frankie Paul is a Gemini with a Scorpio moon.[12] Gallery[] Visit Taylor Frankie Paul's gallery!
